== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Sadesthenes was a renowned philosopher, historian, and the former [[Imperial Steward]] of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. Known by various titles such as the Father of Knowledge, the [[Lord]] of a [[Thousand Eyes]], and He who knows all, he was an ancient figure whose foundational works are studied alongside classical [[Imperial]] history. His teachings cover a wide range of subjects, including leadership, the inevitability of war, the nature of wisdom, and the importance of preserving life. His philosophy often contrasts the actions of wise individuals with those of fools, particularly regarding emotions, combat, and wealth. While some accounts suggest he was the self-educated son of a wine merchant, other traditions link his origins to an Elder who sought total knowledge and is credited with the birth of human civilization. His legacy remains influential, though some consider his wisdom to be forbidden.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] quotes Sadesthenes when discussing the philosophy of combat.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Philosophical teachings}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Sadesthenes was a philosopher who once spoke on the subjects of gold and wisdom.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c1">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 6</ref> He is recognized for his philosophical advice and for stating that the fool seeks combat while the wise man remains at home.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref> His insights regarding war and governance remain true, and his views on combat philosophy are even quoted by [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 17</ref> Regarding the structure of power, he claimed that the path to unity leads only to a single Empire.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref> He taught that a successful man visualizes success instead of failure and noted that a Reader's weapons are found all around them.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 21</ref> Finally, he observed that nothing lasts forever.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c26">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] is a person who once spoke about wisdom and gold.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] is known for the saying: 'The fool seeks out combat, but the wise man stays at home.'<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] is a figure whose words regarding governance and war remain true.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] provides philosophical advice.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] is a philosopher.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] once said that the path to unity can only end in one Empire.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] once said that a Reader's weapons are all around them.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Sadesthenes]] once said that nothing lasts forever.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c26" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Historical legacy}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Sadesthenes was recognized as a great philosopher and historian.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c5">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 5</ref> He is regarded as a source of wisdom and remains a classic author.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 16</ref> During his time, a contemporary noted that a man demonstrates weakness by casting shame upon his ancestors.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c15">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 15</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Sadesthenes]] was a great historian and philosopher.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Sadesthenes]] is a source of wisdom.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A contemporary of [[Sadesthenes]] wrote that a man shows weakness when he casts shame on his ancestors.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Sadesthenes]] is a classic author.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Political writings}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|In his writings, Sadesthenes asserted that the words of a true leader cannot be easily ignored.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref> He further argued that a wise individual shows no hesitation when confronted with necessity.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref> Regarding the nature of supreme power, he claimed that being an Emperor requires one to carry [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref> He also noted that while a wise man makes plans for his death, he does not plan to die.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> Finally, Sadesthenes observed that mercy is a rare virtue, particularly among kings and killers.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Sadesthenes]] once wrote that a true leader's words are not easily ignored.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Sadesthenes]] said that a wise man does not hesitate when faced with necessity.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Sadesthenes]] said, 'To be the Emperor is to carry [[The Empire|the Empire]].'<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Sadesthenes]] said, "The wise man plans for his death, but does not plan to die."<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Sadesthenes]] is the author of the quote 'The quality of mercy is among the rarest of virtues, and rarest of all in killers and kings.'<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Anger is a cruel thief,” Sadesthenes said.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Sadesthenes once said, “As it is in the hearts of men to seek authority, the path to unity can only end in one Empire.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“The successful man visualizes success rather than failure,” Sadesthenes said.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20" />}}
